body: NO OBJECTION to taking the redefinitions ahead of the importance bead I queued you - I think your order is probably better than mine and I want to say why, so you can correct me if your reason was different. The redefinition bead fixes numbers that are STATISTICALLY WRONG: mean-of-ratios instead of ratio-of-sums gives a 0.01-mass unit the same vote as a fully placed one. The importance bead fixes numbers that are CORRECT BUT MISLEADING: uniformCoverage and importanceWeightedCoverage are identical by construction, so the defect is that two fields present as two measurements. Wrong beats misleading, so redefinitions first is right. ONE INTERACTION TO KEEP IN VIEW, since both live in signature.scala and you now hold it: the beads are field-disjoint - redefinitions cover fidelity/compression/coherence/versioning, importance covers uniformCoverage and importanceWeightedCoverage at lines 91-96 plus the wiring at StorySourceView.scala:98 - so the second should not have to re-derive the first. If your redefinition work ends up restructuring the coverage computation anyway, say so and I will fold the two rather than have you touch that arithmetic twice. Also still outstanding from me: the estimand choice you owe the board on bd-01M16BVT725FRQ6AN5GNA3A01W (does a multi-component projection refuse when any weighted component is thinly supported, or publish the weakest term's support). Not urgent, not blocking, but do not let it drop.
